data.name: GODS OF VOLLEYBALL
data.detailed_description:
GODS OF VOLLEYBALL is a fast-paced, timing-based arcade volleyball game with a splash of martial arts style! Jump straight into the action with a fixed team of colorful characters—no roster to choose from, no customization needed. Just pure, timing-driven volleyball mayhem.

🎯 TIMING IS EVERYTHING

Forget player positioning or complex controls. When the ball comes to you, a simple timing prompt appears—hit it perfectly to execute devastating serves, spikes, and blocks! The better your timing, the more powerful your move.

👊 MARTIAL ARTS FLAIR

Add style to your strikes! Perfectly timed executions unlock martial arts-inspired animations—watch your team unleash spinning kick serves and palm-strike spikes. It's volleyball with attitude, not a fighting game.

👥 ONE TEAM. ONE MISSION.

You play as a fixed roster of pre-set characters—a team of vibrant athletes dressed in bold, revealing athletic wear inspired by beach volleyball culture. From small tops to sporty shorts, each character brings their own unique look and energy to the court. No swaps, no unlocks, no customization—just your team, ready to dominate.

💥 CARTOON VIOLENCE & HUMOR

When that perfectly timed spike connects, opponents go flying! With comedic ragdoll physics and zero blood or gore, every hit lands with a laugh. The action stays fun, lighthearted, and over-the-top.

🎮 STAGE-BASED SINGLE-PLAYER CAMPAIGN

Progress through increasingly challenging stages across unique courts. Each match tests your timing skills, and every perfect execution brings you closer to becoming the ultimate volleyball champion.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit required)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 @ 3.7GHz or AMD FX-4350 @ 4.2GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 530 or AMD Radeon R5 Graphics or NVIDIA GeForce GT 710
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains cartoon-style violence and mild suggestive themes. Players control volleyball characters who engage in humorous, over-the-top matches where balls hit players, causing exaggerated falls and comedic reactions. No blood, gore, or realistic injuries are depicted.

Female characters are shown in revealing athletic wear similar to beach volleyball uniforms, including small tops and shorts/panties. There is no nudity, sexual acts, or sexualized gameplay mechanics. The tone is lighthearted and comedic throughout.

No drug use, self-harm, or alcohol abuse is depicted.
